categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Modifies contrib/guix/guix-build and contrib/guix/INSTALL.md, which manage the Guix reproducible build environment.
categories.rationale: Prevents long Guix builds from failing late with confusing permission errors on modern Guix setups using unprivileged user namespaces. The pre-build check and documentation reduce contributor friction when compiling dependencies locally without substitutes.

categories.name: tools
categories.evidence: Build and release scripts are explicitly classified under the build category rather than tools.
categories.rationale: The tools category excludes build and release scripts, which belong to build.
